title: A Youth Council with Real Influence
title_ja: 意見が実際に届く若者会議

source_links.title: OECD: Guidelines for Citizen Participation Processes

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: A city invites students from local schools to discuss plans for improving public spaces and making streets safer.
sentences.ja: 市は公共空間の改善と道路の安全性について話し合うため地元の生徒を招きます。

sentences.en: The students are excited to join a youth council and share ideas with officials who make decisions.
sentences.ja: 生徒は若者会議に参加し意思決定する担当者と考えを共有できることを喜びます。

sentences.en: However, some participants discover that the budget has already been approved and important choices may be impossible to change.
sentences.ja: しかし予算がすでに承認され重要な選択を変えられないかもしれないと知る参加者もいます。

sentences.en: They begin to wonder whether the meeting is a genuine opportunity to influence policy or simply a public event.
sentences.ja: 生徒は会議が政策に影響する本当の機会か、ただの公開行事か疑問に思います。

sentences.en: Inviting young people to speak is not necessarily the same as giving their ideas a meaningful role.
sentences.ja: 若者に話すよう招くことは、その考えに意味ある役割を与えることと必ずしも同じではありません。

sentences.en: The council asks the city to explain which decisions remain open before collecting more suggestions.
sentences.ja: 会議はさらに提案を集める前に何の決定がまだ変更可能か説明するよう市に求めます。

sentences.en: Officials explain that the city can still choose the location of several benches and adjust some walking routes.
sentences.ja: 担当者はベンチの場所や歩行経路の一部をまだ選べると説明します。

sentences.en: For example, students who travel by bicycle suggest places where narrow streets create conflicts between different users.
sentences.ja: 例えば自転車通学の生徒は狭い道路で利用者がぶつかり合う場所を提案します。

sentences.en: Other students identify areas with poor lighting or routes that are difficult for wheelchair users.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は照明が不足する場所や車いすで通りにくい経路を挙げます。

sentences.en: These experiences provide information that city staff may not have noticed during their earlier planning.
sentences.ja: こうした経験は市の職員が以前の計画時に気づかなかった情報になります。

sentences.en: The young people learn that useful participation involves describing problems clearly as well as proposing solutions.
sentences.ja: 若者は役立つ参加には解決策の提案だけでなく問題の明確な説明も含まれると学びます。

sentences.en: Officials agree to compare ideas against safety requirements and the available budget.
sentences.ja: 担当者は案を安全要件と利用できる予算から比較すると約束します。

sentences.en: The council also notices that its members do not represent every teenager in the city.
sentences.ja: 会議の参加者が市のすべての若者を代表するわけではないことにも気づきます。

sentences.en: In addition, students with part-time jobs, care responsibilities, or long journeys may have difficulty attending evening meetings.
sentences.ja: さらにアルバイト、家庭での世話、長い通学のある生徒は夕方の会議に参加しにくいかもしれません。

sentences.en: The group offers a simple written survey and asks schools to share the opportunity with different classes.
sentences.ja: グループは簡単な書面調査を用意し、多様なクラスに機会を伝えるよう学校に頼みます。

sentences.en: They avoid claiming that one popular answer represents all young people without examining who responded.
sentences.ja: 誰が回答したか調べず一つの人気回答を若者全員の意見と主張することは避けます。

sentences.en: A survey with many responses can still fail to represent people who had no chance to participate.
sentences.ja: 回答の多い調査でも参加する機会のない人々を代表できない場合があります。

sentences.en: The council therefore describes its evidence and limitations when presenting its recommendations.
sentences.ja: 会議は提案を示すとき証拠と限界を説明します。

sentences.en: Several months later, the city publishes a summary explaining which suggestions were accepted and which were rejected.
sentences.ja: 数か月後、市は採用した提案と却下した提案を説明する要約を公開します。

sentences.en: The summary includes reasons related to cost, safety, and conflicts between different users of the same public space.
sentences.ja: 要約には費用、安全、同じ公共空間の利用者間の利害対立に関する理由が含まれます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the council recognizes that not every request can become a policy simply because students proposed it.
sentences.ja: それでも若者が提案したというだけですべての要望が政策になるわけではないと会議は理解します。

sentences.en: Members value the opportunity to see how their ideas were considered rather than being promised automatic approval.
sentences.ja: 参加者は自動承認の約束より自分たちの考えがどう検討されたか知る機会を評価します。

sentences.en: A meaningful civic process needs clear boundaries, a chance to influence decisions, and a public explanation of results.
sentences.ja: 意味ある市民参加には明確な範囲、決定に影響する機会、結果の公開説明が必要です。

sentences.en: Young people can learn democratic responsibility by taking part in decisions that are genuinely open to discussion.
sentences.ja: 若者は本当に議論可能な決定に参加することで民主的な責任を学べます。

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: Youth participation requires real influence, broad access, and an explanation of decisions.
Students should control all city budgets.
Only adults can discuss public safety.
questions.explanation_ja: 実質的な参加と説明責任が主題です。

questions.prompt: What problem does the council first notice?
options: The city has no public spaces.
Important budget choices may already be fixed.
questions.explanation_ja: 決定済みの範囲が多い点です。

questions.prompt: Why must officials explain what remains open?
options: All city plans should be secret.
Every suggestion is certain to succeed.
Students need to know where their ideas could affect the result.
questions.explanation_ja: 意見が反映され得る範囲を明確にするためです。

options: Places where narrow streets create conflicts.
questions.explanation_ja: 利用者間の問題が生じる場所です。

questions.prompt: Which needs do other students highlight?
questions.explanation_ja: 照明と通りやすさです。

questions.prompt: Why may a large survey still be unrepresentative?
options: Some young people may have no opportunity to respond.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加機会が偏る場合があるためです。

options: Weaknesses or boundaries of the evidence.

questions.prompt: What does the city's final summary explain?
options: Which suggestions were accepted and why some were rejected.
questions.explanation_ja: 採用・不採用の理由です。

questions.prompt: Why do council members value explanations even after rejection?
options: They can understand how ideas were evaluated within real constraints.
questions.explanation_ja: 検討の過程が見えることに価値があるためです。

questions.prompt: What does the final sentence suggest?
options: Democratic responsibility develops through meaningful participation in open decisions.
Young people must receive every request.
questions.explanation_ja: 実質的参加が民主的学びになると締めくくります。
